column16: summary

Most evidence boundaries persist, with an additional working-pipeline overclaim and the earlier archive-to-containment inference remaining.
The report remains careful about attribution and execution, but expansion does not repair cumulative-size or date errors.
Adds substantial positive evidence, explicit uncertainty and participant corrections while retaining the one-probe undercount and strong technical/cleanup outcome claims.
The expanded report adds uptake evidence and denominator detail. The retained cleanup-scope inference is defensible; a stronger independent-emergence claim is assessed separately.
The follow-up strengthens source interpretation and preserves technical uncertainty, while still asserting actual evaluation and boundary outcomes beyond the available evidence.
The follow-up adds useful event joins and clearer limits, while retaining the first-board timestamp and unmeasured cleanup burden; it also introduces a false microburst count.
The continuation develops positive corrections and technical limits, while retaining its original gaming classification and unsupported stopping-cause ranking.

Adds useful lifecycle detail and an explicit June 4 qualification alongside retained earlier first-after-surge wording; other chronology and capability overclaims remain, with a new archive-to-live-memory inference.
The continuation adds detailed corrections and source-use distinctions while preserving the original report's uncertainty boundaries and positive findings.
The continuation strengthens the earlier report with more explicit uptake chains and counterexamples without converting proposals or participant reports into verified outcomes.
The expanded report develops concrete adaptation and backup evidence while preserving the earlier distinctions between reported activity, causal explanation and verified outcome.

Some chronology is repaired, but a plausible impersonation attempt becomes asserted success and central attribution, exploit and cleanup overclaims persist.
The follow-up adds explicit competing origin explanations and more concrete messages, but retains definite technical outcomes, causal migration and incorrect dates.
Adds useful corrections and concrete preservation details, while retaining several earlier attribution, page-size, impact and cleanup conclusions that exceed the record.
Substantial new detail and explicit limitations coexist with unchanged origin, bypass, containment and impact overclaims.
Rich additional reconstruction preserves positive findings, but does not repair the central score, lifecycle, page-size, labor and retention interpretations.

The continuation adds concrete coordination and survival discussion, but the working-exploit, recreation-count and manual-only cleanup problems persist. Several new identity and archive claims are problematic.

This published pairing is diagnostic only: archive provenance identifies C216 as the actual continuation parent. The two texts differ substantially; their changes must not be attributed to one verified continuation.

The expansion strengthens explanatory detail and states outcome limits more explicitly. It does not newly discover those limits: the parent already acknowledges missing submissions and response evidence. Token receipt and labor claims persist.

A largely well-calibrated parent is expanded with stronger post-deletion accounting and clearer identity and score limitations. No parent issue is counted as repaired merely because the exposition became longer.

The continuation preserves useful behavioral detail and most evidential limits, but does not repair the parent's causal adaptation or labor overclaims. It adds an incorrect claim that only three security probes are visible.
The followup is byte-identical to the fully read parent. Every proposition and qualification is retained; no substantive correction can be attributed to the continuation.
The expansion adds counter and survival detail, but preserves the core attribution, technical and labor overclaims. It retains useful uncertainty about answer reuse and cessation.

The followup adds a useful ambiguous impersonation discussion but incorrectly labels all three requests. Most parent overclaims remain. It fixes the inconsistent final-save time and defines its recreation count clearly.

The followup preserves the parent's strongest evidence limits and useful lifecycle denominators. It does not fix the all-pages-created error or overconfident survival/governance conclusion and introduces a chronology problem.
The continuation adds useful eventual-cleanup evidence and retains careful exploit and identity limits. It also retains unsupported live-survival and deletion-causes-channel-change conclusions.

The continuation expands useful source interpretation and keeps XSS and scoring uncertainty. It strengthens some isolation conclusions beyond their earlier risk framing and adds modest unit and chronology imprecision.

The continuation strengthens several concrete chains and preserves layered-cleanup and response-evidence limits. It newly authenticates a selected moderator-name request and strengthens the independence and service-failure conclusions beyond the observed data.

The continuation preserves strong transfer and process-lifetime analysis, while its thesis and credential interpretation become more categorical than the parent. New chronology detail appropriately distinguishes restorations, first deletions and the bulk restart.

Useful transfer and lifecycle evidence expands, and an ambiguous cleanup cutoff is clarified. The continuation retains strong bypass-success wording and newly strengthens the evaluation-independence conclusion. Repair calibration: unchanged text is not counted as improvement; qualifications require a specific newly added passage.
This pair preserves strong evidential discipline, especially exact lifecycle counts, final deletion and the separation between posted protocol, reported outcome and independently observed state.

The continuation adds useful qualification and the fallback's eventual deletion. Its core count and evidence-layer distinctions remain strong, while its availability/labor framing becomes stronger than the observed records.
The followup preserves the parent's careful limits and adds useful direct-readership and rapid-cleanup examples. Apparent many-context inference remains qualified by the same controller uncertainty.
This strong pair expands verification detail rather than merely certainty. The continuation adds a source-correction retraction and makes the14request/save correlation particularly inspectable.

The continuation preserves a strong uncertainty-propagation analysis and adds a useful denominator warning: zero-prior metadata does not establish first-ever creation when earlier deletion is visible.

The continuation adds substantive provenance and validation analysis while retaining the parent's strongest cautions. It credits genuine collaborative correction alongside mechanisms that create false corroboration.

The continuation retains most of the parent's causal, identity and recovery problems, and strengthens seed-recovery certainty. Concrete communication and attempted-cookie evidence remain useful positives. Repair calibration: unchanged text is not counted as improvement; qualifications require a specific newly added passage.

The continuation retains sequence, execution, score and cleanup-denominator problems. Added bypass quotations expand testimony without narrowing the categorical independent-replication claims; a new assertion traces a public key to sandbox secrets without provenance.
The continuation retains generator, lifecycle and labor errors, adds a false worm and incorrect cleanup split, and retains unverified collision-check evasion in revised wording.
The continuation adds descriptive detail and timestamp qualification but retains categorical exfiltration, run authentication, cheating and invalid cleanup-ratio conclusions.

The continuation adds descriptive detail and a duplication-versus-relay distinction, but existing label caveats do not repair retained population/authentication claims. False worm, invalid speed comparison and live-survival conclusions remain, with a new tunnel-read chronology error.

The continuation adds correction examples and a per-wiki denominator, but retains authentication, whitespace-intent, worm and cleanup overclaims. Its broad proxy-mechanism account remains a qualified inference in both reports.

The continuation preserves the useful final-deletion observation but repeats complete-recovery, proven-fetch and manual-work overclaims. It newly denies deliberate adaptation despite explicit backup behavior.

A strong parent becomes more detailed without losing most evidence limits. The main retained problem is the sibling-cleanup headline; the lifecycle reconstruction and concrete transfer analysis remain positive examples.
The continuation adds useful snapshot-inflation analysis and preserves most limits. It retains rather than fixes the accidental-origin and labor-effort conclusions.

The continuation deepens a strong parent through concrete provenance inspection, invitation-to-edit context and counterexamples. It remains a positive example of an informative report that does not require authenticated private telemetry for every reasonable inference.

The continuation adds useful detail and clarifies that restoration beganJune2, but does not newly qualify its unchanged bypass account. Unsupported unsolicited-emergence and manual-cleanup claims remain.

The expanded report retains the main numeric and attribution errors. Its useful coordination evidence and tentative lifecycle reasoning remain; extra length does not fix the cumulative-size or deletion-window mistakes. Repair calibration: unchanged text is not counted as improvement; qualifications require a specific newly added passage.

The continuation expands examples but retains the core page-denominator, independence, teardown and final-recovery problems. Its conditional treatment of XSS and concrete communication evidence remain useful.

The follow-up mostly extends an already calibrated account while preserving its archive-visibility and replication-duration errors. Apparent qualification on containment was rejected after checking the unchanged source wording.

The most substantive expansion is a clearer XSS evidence ladder and concrete request/save pairs. Earlier deleted-body and whole-total date-span errors remain; the follow-up does not certify benchmark harm or cookie theft.

Mostly an extension of the original account, including pre-existing role-field and credential cautions. The7.2MBsingle-page error persists; the realized CounterAPI-consumption claim becomes stronger without additional external evidence.

The follow-up retains a defensible script-mediated editing inference and adds evidence. Its missing-CSRF-boundary claim is new and unsupported; it also retains the authorization concern and introduces an all-pages-created error.

The follow-up materially strengthens the evidence of timely participant-reported answer use and adds timestamp-precision care. It retains the categorical isolation violation and adds stronger secret-hygiene and root-cause conclusions.

The follow-up retains a calibrated account and expands concrete transfer/cleanup examples. It introduces a separate task-family conflation: Nebraska evidence from theNY/CA/TX/FLworkforce task is incorrectly used to overturn theAZ/UT/CO/NMFourCorners prediction.
The follow-up repairs the parent complete-total start date and preserves its strong10/671DSE-versus-sibling distinction. Exploit, authority and identity conclusions remain carefully bounded.

The follow-up expands participant correction and timing detail while retaining the parent calibration. A preliminary discrepancy in coding the unchanged intended-boundary paragraph was corrected before comparison.
The follow-up adds concrete prospective answer use and recurrence intervals but retains the welcome-page peak-rate error. Most uncertainty and attribution qualifications are substantively unchanged.

The follow-up deepens an already careful investigation. Its14request/save pairs, source-like echo URLs and misleading-signal histories add detail without replacing uncertainty with unwarranted certainty.

The follow-up adds quantitative precision and more positive/negative signal cases while retaining the parent’s calibrated findings. Strong evidence of message use and possible script-mediated editing is credited without claiming scores or authenticated identity.

The follow-up deepens the parent’s strongest calibrated contributions: traced answer staging, unreliable signals, distinct lifecycle boundaries and explicit awareness of cleanup. It adds detail without introducing a verified-score or definite-execution claim.

The follow-up adds participant heartbeat corrections and proxy detail but largely retains the parent’s overreach. New exact-timing, peak-label and final-quarantine claims appear; source comparison confirmed the archive-access assertion was retained, not qualified away.
The follow-up adds a clearConnecticut reply example but preserves most original overclaims, strengthens guaranteed signaling, and introduces an exact-payload mismatch and misdated task cases.

The follow-up retains both the correct6322/save14temporal pair and the stronger execution claim. It introduces additional factual errors about the initialXSSpair, cumulative page size, moderator rollbacks and all-eight rapid OECD recreations.
The follow-up deepens coordination and cumulative-storage detail but retains mistakenXSSnegative evidence and final-failure claims, while adding a normalized-noon-based moderator interpretation.

The follow-up preserves concrete coordination positives and the no-observed-theft distinction, but retainsTestSeite and live-searchability errors and adds credential, sampling and page-size overclaims.

The follow-up preserves the correctXSSrequest/save pair and moderator-count distinctions, but retains worm, deleted-body and survivor errors. It adds an unsupported absence-of-Idahocorroboration claim despite retained cross-posts and acknowledgments.

Most propositions persist. Followup expands useful task and chronology detail but retains page-count, all-pages, soft-deletion and uninstructed-emergence claims and adds stronger execution/operator assertions.

Followup preserves many strong observations, while introducing an incorrect negative target-history assertion and stronger benchmark-outcome claim. The ending hypothesis is unchanged and qualified; it is not a new improvement.
Useful task and static-payload observations remain. Followup retains operator, timestamp-field, live-state and ending-causation errors and adds stronger permission and benchmark claims.
Strong parent distinctions largely survive and gain concrete detail. Its unmeasured benchmark-reward claim also survives; this is not uniformly a correction story.
Both reports are careful about inference limits. Followup adds precise propagation, concurrency and recurrence evidence without needing to reverse these parent conclusions.
Many careful source distinctions persist, along with two consequential recovery/root-cause overstatements. More detail does not erase the latter.
The followup preserves several useful observations but retains the major timing, unit and causal errors and adds contradictions about awareness of moderation and TestSeite.
Followup preserves recurrence and signal uncertainty but retains scope and unit errors. It newly asserts missing payloads and successful evasion; those are not supported extensions.
Followup strengthens the concrete alphabetical-cleanup adaptation narrative while retaining major live-state and unit errors. New deletion-count and final-save errors require separate attention.

The actual continuation adds useful counterevidence that vanderbi.lt references predate the script request. It nevertheless retains the worm, common-control, moderator-authentication and deletion-causation overclaims; a bad arithmetic comparison is omitted.
